LightningComponentBundle.description: Currency selector. Resolves the active payment currency (Hybrid allow-list + default source), emits it on load, and collapses to a fixed currency when only one is available. Usable on an Experience Cloud page and as a Flow screen component.

property.name: allowedCurrencies
property.label: Allowed currencies (CSV)
property.description: Comma-separated ISO 4217 codes, e.g. EUR,USD. Leave empty to use a single default currency.

property.name: defaultCurrency
property.label: Default currency (ISO)
property.description: Initial currency shown on load, e.g. EUR.

property.name: currencySource
property.label: Default currency source
property.description: Where the initial currency comes from: fixed (admin default), user (logged-in user), or page (page property / URL param).

property.name: pageCurrency
property.label: Page currency (when source = page)
property.description: ISO code passed from the page context; used only when Default currency source = page.
